paragraphs: Week 11 (Nov 20 – 24, Lectures 21 and 22) Teaching and Learning

7.8 Relative rates of growth (continued from Week 10 if unfinished): comparing growth rates of functions and formal definitions; big-O and little-o notation; a technique for computing limits of products of quotients by replacing a function with one with the same growth rate (等价代换) --- this technique is not explicitly stated in the book --- see the file “1001lec20 2022”.
8.2 Integration by parts: indefinite integral version; reduction formulae (Example 5); definite integral version; tabular integration (shortcut for multiple iterations of integration by parts).
8.3 Trigonometric integrals: products of powers of sine and cosine; products of powers of tangent and secant; eliminating square roots (Example 4); products of sin(mx) and cos(nx).
8.4 Trigonometric substitutions: the three forms 1-x^2, x^2-1, and 1+x^2, and their trig substitutions by sin, sec, and tan.
